title: finding(plugin-grid): `gridNeedsDataSource` still reads a bare `data` array as "no adapter needed", so after objectui#9571 the grid draws nothing and the no-data-source gate stays silent
body:
Filed by the `domain:ui` execution seat (`session_01XeoGH6X7MtfbjcRDscyXi1`) from the `out_of_scope_findings` of the objectui#9571 dev report (`5690223524`), class (a) — a reproducible defect. The dev correctly ⛔ did not repair it: `packages/plugin-grid/src/index.tsx` is SOURCE outside that card's declared file surface.

## What is wrong

`gridNeedsDataSource` in `packages/plugin-grid/src/index.tsx` still returns **false** when `Array.isArray(schema?.data)` — i.e. it still answers 「this placement can draw rows without an adapter」 because an authored bare `data` array is present.

That reason is now false on both carriers:

- **objectui#8348** (「8348 以协议为准」, batch #83) retired the bare-array `data` shorthand at the shared record-source ladder.
- **objectui#9571** (ruling objectui#8348 Q2-C, batch #136 item 3, maintainer 「同意」) retires the second carrier — `SchemaRenderer` no longer spreads an authored `data` as a React prop for `view-data`-arm blocks, which `object-grid` is.

## The reproducible consequence

Author a grid with a bare `data` array, an `objectName`, and **no** adapter. After objectui#9571 lands:

- the authored array no longer reaches the block by either carrier, so it draws **nothing**;
- and `gridNeedsDataSource` still reads the array as 「no adapter needed」, so the **no data source** gate stays **silent**.

⇒ an empty grid with the one gate that exists to explain exactly this saying nothing.

⚠️ Partially mitigated, ⛔ not closed: objectui#9571 adds a `__DEV__`-only warn-once at the strip site naming the dropped key and the spelling that works, so the author is not told *nothing* in a dev build. The gate itself is still wrong, and it is the production-facing one.

## Why this did not block objectui#9571

Recorded so it is not re-litigated: the authored bare array **ceasing to draw is the ruling**, ⛔ not a regression introduced by that PR. This card is the stale gate left behind, and it is a separate file in a separate concern.

## Suggested acceptance

- `gridNeedsDataSource` no longer treats `Array.isArray(schema?.data)` as evidence that a placement can draw without an adapter, so the 「no data source」 gate fires for the reproduction above.
- A pin that can go red: the gate's verdict for a grid with a bare `data` array plus `objectName` plus no adapter, shown failing before the repair.
- ⛔ Do not re-open the bare-array carrier itself — objectui#8348 and objectui#9571 both ruled it closed. This card is only about what the gate SAYS.

## Governing text

- objectui#8348 rulings: 「8348 以协议为准」 (batch #83) and Q2-C (batch #136 item 3).
- AGENTS.md #0.1 — one key, one honoured spelling; a gate that describes a retired carrier is the same drift class.

Refs: objectui#9571 · PR objectui#9578 · objectui#8348 · objectui#5378 item 2

Dedup terms for triage: `gridNeedsDataSource` · `requiresDataSource` · `bare array escape hatch` · `ElementDataSourceGate` · `objectui#5378 item 2`
